trello_card.name: [P0] VC: Aonic - Sten Düring
trello_card.description:
## Aonic - VC Outreach Packet

### Fund Overview
- **Fund Name:** Aonic
- **Location:** London, UK / Hamburg, Germany
- **AUM:** $100M+ gaming-focused fund
- **Stage Focus:** Seed to Series A
- **Check Size:** $500K - $5M

### Investment Thesis
Aonic is a gaming-focused investment firm and operational partner. They build, buy, and invest in gaming companies with a focus on:
- Mobile and cross-platform gaming
- Gaming infrastructure and tools
- Game studios with innovative mechanics
- Technology enabling next-generation gaming experiences

**AI/Gaming Infrastructure Alignment:** HIGH
- Recently acquired exmox (performance marketing/UA platform) - infrastructure play
- Strong focus on technology and data-driven gaming
- Active in gaming adtech and monetization infrastructure

### Key Partner: Sten Düring
- **Title:** Managing Partner & Co-Founder
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/stenduring/
- **Email:** sten@aonic.com (inferred)
- **Background:** Serial gaming entrepreneur; previously founded adtech companies; deep expertise in gaming monetization

**Secondary Contact: Paul Kasek
- Managing Partner & Co-Founder
- Based in Hamburg
- Gaming operations and investment expertise

### Notable Portfolio Companies & Acquisitions
- **exmox** - Gaming performance marketing platform (acquired 2024)
- **Homa Games** - Hyper-casual publisher (strategic partnership)
- **Sensortower** - Mobile intelligence platform (early investor)
- **GameAnalytics** - Analytics platform for games
- **Fyber** - Mobile ad mediation (exited)

### Recent Activity
- 2024: Acquired exmox to expand gaming infrastructure capabilities
- Active in European gaming ecosystem
- Growing portfolio of gaming tools and infrastructure
- Focus on data/AI-driven gaming investments

### Outreach Angle
**Primary Hook:** Gaming infrastructure that powers monetization and UA - Aonic understands this deeply through their exmox acquisition and GameAnalytics/Sensortower history. Position as the AI layer that enables smarter monetization and player acquisition.

**Secondary Hooks:**
1. European gaming ecosystem connection
2. Data/AI-driven investment focus
3. Infrastructure over content (complementary to their studio investments)
4. exmox acquisition shows active interest in gaming adtech

### Outreach Strategy
1. Reference exmox acquisition - shows they understand gaming infrastructure
2. Emphasize AI for monetization and UA optimization
3. Lead with data/technical angle (aligns with their portfolio)
4. European angle - good for their geographic focus

### Unique Value Proposition
Aonic combines investment with operational expertise. They don't just write checks - they actively build gaming businesses. For infrastructure plays, this means potential operational partnerships, not just capital.

### Resources
- Website: https://aonic.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/aonic/
